mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.place_id AS placeId, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.content, c.image_key AS imageKey, u.nickname, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.place_id = #{placeId} AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( place_id, user_id, content, image_key ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{imageKey} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.place_id AS placeId, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.content, c.image_key AS imageKey, u.nickname, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.place_id = #{placeId} AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND c.image_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
